cohort: Infants and their mothers in Nigeria who participated in the 2013 Nigerian Demographic and Health Survey (NDHS).
finding: Several factors were associated with early initiation of breastfeeding, including delivery in a health facility, vaginal delivery, multiparity, large infant size at birth, not working, higher household wealth, and urban residence.
mod_finding: Mothers who had vaginal deliveries were three times more likely to initiate early breastfeeding compared to mothers who had cesarean sections.
